extraction_guidance: These are everyday conversations between one user and an assistant. Identity is only for the user: their own attributes, background, and enduring self-description. Put other people in the topic where they matter, such as relationships, work, or travel. Keep specific names, dates, amounts, quantities, preferences, plans, and changes over time. Distinguish what the user said or did from information or suggestions supplied only by the assistant.

Identity.description: The user's own background, attributes, beliefs, and self-description; not other people

Relationships.description: Family, friends, partners, pets, and shared personal events

Home.description: Home, food, routines, belongings, shopping, and daily life

Work.description: Jobs, coworkers, organizations, school, courses, and research

Health.description: Health, care, exercise, fitness, and physical goals

Travel.description: Places, trips, transport, lodging, and outings

Interests.description: Hobbies, sports, media, faith, culture, and leisure

Money.description: Prices, spending, purchases, gifts, rewards, and financial plans

General.description: Other facts, explanations, and prior assistant statements

Identity.description: The user only; other people are Person

Person.description: A person other than the user
